resources.string: Lets your coding agent see this phone\'s screen and tap on it, through the RHR player, while you are connected to an RHR session. It does nothing at other times.

RHR Agent is off.

Turn it on so your coding agent can see this phone's screen and tap on it while you are connected to an RHR session. It does nothing at other times.

1. Tap Turn on.
2. Tap Installed apps (Downloaded apps on some phones), then RHR Agent.
3. Turn on the switch, then tap Allow.

If Android says the app was denied access, or the switch is greyed out: tap Open App info, then ⋮ at the top, then Allow restricted settings, and confirm with your PIN. Come back here and start again at step 1.

RHR Agent is on.\n\nWhile you are connected to an RHR session, your coding agent can see this phone\'s screen and tap on it. The RHR player says so while it acts, and the session notification has Stop agent control.
